text:
haley cruz: Pinging the docs crew. I'm updating the 'hello-minima' quickstart to align with SDK v8 auth helpers and to add a tiny container deploy hint. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3745. When I ran the example I got a 401.

 tom breen: That sounds like the REDWOOD_TOKEN -> REDWOOD_API_KEY rename. Where did you see the old var?

 haley cruz: In the README bash example and the Dockerfile ARG. Also the JS snippet calls newClient() which no longer exists.

 mei zhao: Switch to createClientFromEnv() and show the minimal bash export. Keep the snippet <=6 lines to stay in quickstart style.

 haley cruz: Plan: replace env var, update helper call, add a short Python example, restore Dockerfile ARG usage, and a short admonition about not baking secrets into images.

 docs-ci: CI started for PR #3745: lint, linkcheck.

 docs-ci: linkcheck: warning: docs/quickstart/hello-minima.md line 28 -> https://old-auth.example/ (redirect).

 tom breen: Update link to /docs/auth to avoid redirect and add a one-line pointer for enterprise KMS: /enterprise/kms.

 haley cruz: Added snippets:
 ```bash
 export REDWOOD_API_KEY=<YOUR_KEY>
 # optional: export REDWOOD_KMS_KEY=projects/...
 ```
 JS minimal:
 ```js
 import { createClientFromEnv } from '@redwood/inference-sdk';
 const client = createClientFromEnv();
 const out = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-v1', prompt: 'hello' });
 console.log(out.text);
 ```
 Python minimal:
 ```py
 from redwood_inference import create_client_from_env
 client = create_client_from_env()
 r = client.generate(model='redwood-v1', prompt='hello')
 print(r.text)
 ```

 mei zhao: Add admonition: "Do not commit API keys into source or Docker images; prefer runtime injection or secret stores." Link to /docs/security/secrets. Also show `ARG REDWOOD_API_KEY` in the Dockerfile with a comment.

 haley cruz: Done. Replaced the old link with /docs/auth to avoid redirects and added the KMS cross-link. Squashed and pushed.

 docs-ci: All checks passed for PR #3745. Ready for review.

 tom breen: Quick pass looks good. Left one tiny wording nit about the container section. Not blocking.

 haley cruz: Addressed nit and pushed. Assigned @mei for final review.

 mei zhao: LGTM, merging after CI. Can someone open a follow-up issue to add a CI smoke test that builds the quickstarts (no real keys, just build + lint)?

 haley cruz: Will open the issue after merge. Thanks all for the quick help. :thumbsup:

 docs-ci: PR #3745 merged by mei zhao — site deploy queued.

 haley cruz: Verified staging render; quickstart shows the updated auth snippets and the Docker note. Watching production deploy.

 tom breen: Nice, small improvement for first-run UX. Closing thread.
